messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Page to oncall for HIGH latency spike affecting /v1/generate in us-east-1 (pg=oncall). Incident ID INC-2026-0315-173

sam (oncall): ack'd. I'm pulling up dashboards now. seeing error-rate jump ~12:04 UTC, tail latency 95p -> 2.1s

maya (SRE): thanks. I'm ssh'ing into node gpu-03, running `htop` and `nvidia-smi` — looks like one model-worker's process stuck at 100% GPU mem

sam (oncall): can you try killing the worker to force restart? I'll coordinate healthcheck and routing

maya (SRE): doing `sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference-worker@3` ... restarting

incidents-bot: Deploybot: Canary deploy to production completed 03:58 UTC — no rollback triggered

sam (oncall): after restart, 95p latency back to ~220ms. Request rate normalized. I'm going to open a status page incident note and draft a customer notification

elsa (Customer Success): thanks for the heads-up. I have two enterprise customers on scheduled calls in next hour; need a short customer-facing blurb and ETA for follow-up

raj (Support): I'll message affected accounts (account ids: acct-753, acct-991) with initial notification. Template please

tim (Status): Status page draft posted (incidents.redwood.com/INC-2026-0315-173). Current state: Mitigated. Update: Investigating root cause. — please review

sam (oncall): root cause appears to be a memory leak in 3rd-party quantization lib used by model v1.2.4; worker didn't free KV cache under specific request patterns. Patch candidate: pin quant-lib to 2.1.7

maya (SRE): opened PR #5123 with the temporary mitigation (process-level watchdog that restarts stuck workers after 90s). Will ship to canary in 10m. Also adding metrics for per-worker KV cache size

elsa (Customer Success): customer-facing summary for follow-up email (feel free to edit):

````
Hi —

We experienced elevated latency for text generation in us-east-1 on 2026-03-15 between ~12:04 and 12:22 UTC impacting a subset of requests. Our on-call SREs mitigated the issue by restarting affected workers, and we have implemented a temporary watchdog to prevent recurrence while we deploy a longer-term fix. No customer data was accessed beyond normal request handling and we have no evidence of data loss.

Next steps: - Patch to pin the quantization library underway; - Additional KV-cache telemetry and restart watchdog will be deployed to production by EOD; - We will provide a full RCA with timeline and preventive actions within 48 hours.

Sorry for the disruption — reach out if you'd like a meeting to discuss.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference
````

sam (oncall): couple notes for the email: remove 'no evidence of data loss' -> say 'no evidence of data exfiltration or loss' for legal clarity. Also add link to status page. I'll include a short timeline snippet

elsa (Customer Success): updated draft and sending to affected accounts now. I'll cc PM/engineering for any escalations. Template I'll use for other customers:

- Subject: Brief service disruption in us-east-1 — short summary
- Body: first paragraph, mitigation, impact (latency only for subset of generation requests), safety (no evidence of data exfiltration), timeline link

maya (SRE): follow-up internal timeline note for RCA: 
- 12:03 UTC: increase in latency observed by service monitors
- 12:04 UTC: incidents-bot paged oncall
- 12:05 UTC: sam ack'd and started triage
- 12:09 UTC: identified stuck worker on gpu-03
- 12:12 UTC: restarted worker; partial mitigation
- 12:18 UTC: rollouts of watchdog to canary complete
- 12:22 UTC: system returned to expected baselines

sam (oncall): adding preventative action list
- pin quant-lib to 2.1.7 across pools
- add autoscaler alert when per-worker KV cache > 90% mem
- add process watchdog (auto-restart on stuck state)
- more extensive load tests for request patterns that stress KV cache

elsa (Customer Success): any guidance on SLAs/credits? Customer A is asking for compensation

maya (SRE): impact is latency only, short window; pass to finance/sales for credit guidance. I'll include severity classification: P2 service degradation

raj (Support): noted. I'll triage inbound account replies and escalate if they request formal credits

tim (Status): I updated the status page to 'Resolved' at 12:30 UTC and included link to the post-incident follow-up doc (internal)

sam (oncall): final note: I'll link PR #5123 and the test run in the RCA. Also scheduling a 1-hour postmortem sync tomorrow 14:00 UTC — invite: eng, platform, cs, support

elsa (Customer Success): thanks — I'll prepare the customer RCA summary for the 48-hour follow-up, make sure legal reviews the wording regarding data

maya (SRE): creating JIRA RED-837 to track permanent fix and telemetry work

elsa (Customer Success): sent emails to affected accounts at 12:40 UTC; replies to me and cc'ing eng where needed

sam (oncall): closing incident INC-2026-0315-173 in internal tracker. If anything reappears ping me.

incidents-bot: NOTE: This thread will be auto-archived in 7 days. :robot_face:
